Description
Lunar Series products are increasingly popular among investors and collectors around the world. The ever-changing designs, multiple product options (coins, bars, etc.), and impressive purity of these products makes them a must-have in the minds of many. Today, the 1 oz
PAMP Suisse
Lunar Rooster Gold Bar is available in brand-new condition from Bulliontradingllc. Bar Highlights: Contains 1 troy oz of .9999 pure gold. Features the exclusive Year of the Rooster design. Minted in Switzerland at PAMP Suisse. Part of the Lunar Series of gold bars. Each bar is in brand-new condition and ships with an Assay Card. Individual bars ship in sealed plastic, with multiples of 25 available in boxes. The Chinese Lunar Calendar is a 12-year cycle that has different animals associated with the birth years that fall into each 12-year rotation. Individuals born under specific animals in the cycle are said to share personality and character traits, both positive and negative, with the animal that represents their year of birth. PAMP Suisse is the world’s leading bullion brand. Founded in Ticino, Switzerland in 1971, it is today part of the global MKS Group. The MKS brand has operations around the globe that cover both precious metals and financial services.
